title: Friday Night Pizza Sauce (with Hidden Veggies)
summary: Looking for a flavorful pizza sauce you can whip up while your oven pre-heats? Then this is the pizza sauce for you!
ingredients: 1/2-1 cup carrots, shredded or finely chopped (see notes)
steps: In a medium saucepan over medium-low heat, add the olive oil and let warm for 2 minutes. Add in the garlic and carrots and saute for 2 minutes.
Add in the tomatoes, tomato puree, salt, and oregano. Turn heat to medium and let simmer for a minimum of 8-10 minutes.
Transfer to a blender and puree for 1-2 minutes or until smooth. You can also use a hand immersion blender. Let cool slightly and use it for a pizza.
